title: Pharmacy ERP — Inventory Contract (Stage 1)
description: Locations, batches, balances, append-only ledger, adjustments. Balances are a projection; the ledger (INVENTORY_TXN + lines) is authoritative. FE never picks batch/location for returns — the server derives them from posted allocations. Initial stock is NEVER pushed by cloud; it is posted locally via OPENING_BALANCE.

LocationType.description: is_sellable=true is permitted only for SELLABLE; QUARANTINE and SCRAP are always non-sellable. Damaged stock is tracked via batch quality_status=QUARANTINED in a quarantined batch location, not a separate location type.

BatchQualityStatus.description: Never sellable: expired-by-date, RECALLED, QUARANTINED, or in a non-sellable location. Date eligibility is checked independently of stored status.

InventoryBatchDto.description: READ-ONLY via API: batch rows are created only by opening-balance/receipt ledger workflows.

batch_id.description: Deterministic UUIDv5 (RFC 4122 DNS namespace); identical for the same (organization, product, batch_number, expires_on) across ALL branches.

manufactured_on.description: Optional; when present cannot exceed expires_on.

expires_on.description: Required for lot-tracked products; NULL only for the reserved NON-LOT batch of lot_tracking_required=false products.

is_non_lot.description: True for reserved batch_number=NON-LOT with NULL dates.

InventoryBalanceDto.description: Concurrency-safe projection over the ledger. Unique (organization, location, batch).

available_qty_base.description: Server-derived eligible quantity: sum of on_hand from SELLABLE locations for batches that are AVAILABLE, not expired by business date, and not recalled. With no reservations in MVP this normally equals eligible on_hand, not raw on_hand across all locations. Never negative.

InventoryTxnType.description: Sign convention: IN/receipt types positive, ISSUE/OUT types negative. REVERSAL exactly negates its original; the original stays POSTED and immutable.

InventoryTxnStatus.description: Edits allowed only while DRAFT. POSTED rows + lines are immutable (DB-enforced). CANCELLED is for unposted drafts only.

batch_id.description: NOT NULL; NON-LOT sentinel for non-lot-tracked products.

product_uom_id.description: Product's BASE UOM for ledger lines.

entered_qty.description: = abs(quantity_delta_base) on ledger lines; strictly positive.

conversion_snapshot.description: = 1 on ledger lines; conversion must be >0.

InventoryTxnLineRequest.description: One line per FE input. Ledger stores base-UOM representation; conversion fields are snapshotted server-side.

batch_id.description: Use the system NON-LOT batch (get its id from /inventory/batches) for non-lot-tracked products.

unit_cost_base.description: REQUIRED for ADJUSTMENT_IN / OPENING_BALANCE. Omitted for ADJUSTMENT_OUT; the server uses the current balance cost. Reversals/RESTOCK reuse the original posted cost. Never negative.

transaction_type.description: Adjustment endpoint only. Ledger-generated types (SALE_ISSUE, SALES_RETURN_IN, PURCHASE_RECEIPT, VENDOR_RETURN_OUT, SCRAP_OUT) are server-created by their owning workflows and cannot be posted here.

reverses_inventory_txn_id.description: REQUIRED when transaction_type=REVERSAL; must reference a POSTED transaction in the same branch.

InventoryTxnPatchRequest.description: Partial edit for a DRAFT adjustment only. transaction_type, branch_id, and reverses_inventory_txn_id are immutable after creation. Posted transactions are immutable and must be corrected by a new REVERSAL.
